accounting.scope: Entire wildfire project since Oct15, including experiments predating32; conservative broader scope than campaign
accounting.limitations: VM successful-insert completion to delete request is approximate allocation time; preemption/startup accounting differs. East4 and West4 G2 use a conservative1.20USD/VM-hour bound. N1 with exactly one T4 and Flex-start use a conservative0.80USD/VM-hour upper estimate until exact SKU/posted resource charges are reconciled; no discount is assumed. Spot rates estimated from rounded posted SKU amounts. Shared costs use currently posted disk/IP/workflow totals. Not invoice or per-job actual charges. Compare full runtime/shared estimate against posted plus only entirely post-cutoff VM allocations; never add overlapping totals. Unposted shared costs and partial-period billing remain uncertain.
